'''Flounut butter''' was made from [[flounut]]s. One of the [[Manarai]] [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant's]] most famed dishes was [[giant Ithorian snail]]s in flounut butter.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>
